mapper.select: SELECT COM.CM_IDX AS CM_IDX, COM.CM_U_IDX AS CM_U_IDX, COM.CM_B_IDX AS CM_B_IDX, COM.CM_CONTENT AS CM_CONTENT, DATE_FORMAT(COM.CM_DATE, '%y/%m/%d %H:%i') AS CM_DATE, COM.CM_MODIFY AS CM_MODIFY, COM.CM_PARENT_IDX AS CM_PARENT_IDX, USR.U_NICNAME AS U_NICNAME, CPN.C_NICNAME AS C_NICNAME FROM COMMENT AS COM INNER JOIN USER AS USR ON COM.CM_U_IDX = USR.U_IDX INNER JOIN BOARD AS BRD ON COM.CM_B_IDX = BRD.B_IDX INNER JOIN COMPANY AS CPN ON CPN.C_IDX = USR.U_C_IDX WHERE CM_B_IDX = #{cm_b_idx} ORDER BY COM.CM_PARENT_IDX IS NOT NULL, COM.CM_PARENT_IDX, COM.CM_DATE
